title: The held threat

D0.outcome: Explains that a held threat ties the opponent's forces and that carrying it out frees them.

D1.outcome: In a given position, identifies the held threat and the pieces it ties down.

D2.outcome: In unlabeled positions, decides to keep holding the threat or to execute it, executing only when something is gained at once.

D3.outcome: Predicts the effect of executing too early, and tells a real held threat from a bluff built on fictitious threats.

misconceptions: Execute a threat as soon as it exists.
conditions: A threat held in hand ties the opponent's forces; executing it releases them, so execute only if something is gained immediately.
contrasts: A bluff built on fictitious threats ('false chess').
